{{Quote|You had an infiltrator?''"<br />"''The 203rd did.|Commanders Appo and Vill of the 501st Legion|<ref name="Dark Times 4">[[Dark Times 4|''Dark Times'' 4]]</ref>}}
The '''203rd Division''' was a [[clone stormtrooper]] [[Division/Legends|division]] that was situated on [[New Plympto/Legends|New Plympto]] and served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Dark Times 2" /> Initially, the 203rd served in the Empire's predecessor, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], with at least one member of the division, a [[Unidentified clone trooper lieutenant (New Plympto)|clone lieutenant]], being involved in the search for the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Dass Jennir]] during the implementation of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]].<ref name="Republic 79" />

They were headquartered in a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], for which they provided security, on the surface near the local [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] headquarters, of which a [[Unidentified brigade (501st Legion)|brigade]] had been tasked with eliminating the local resistance. Jennir, who became a resistance fighter and fugitive, managed to impersonate a [[Clone Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of the 501st and steal an [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter/Legends|Alpha-3 ''Nimbus''-class V-wing starfighter]] which was being serviced by a member of the 203rd.<ref name="Dark Times 2" />

The trooper of the 203rd was refueling the craft when Jennir kicked him down and stole the fighter. As he left, other clones of the division went on alert. Jennir soon launched a faux attack on civilian ships in the spaceport in a ruse to have them all take off and leave New Plympto, all while allowing his crew to escape as well. [[Unidentified clone trooper officer (203rd Division)|An officer]] of the 203rd ordered clone pilots to stop the evacuating ships and to get airborne, but they were unsuccessful.<ref name="Dark Times 2" /> The incident was later recounted by 501st Legion [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commanders]] [[Appo/Legends|CC-1119]] "Appo" and "[[Vill]]."<ref name="Dark Times 3">[[Dark Times 3|''Dark Times'' 3]]</ref>

The 203rd Division sported [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II clone trooper armor]] that sported a [[Color/Legends|yellow]] half circle on the right side of the [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]] and a yellow utility belt. Along with the officer,<ref name="Dark Times 2" /> and the lieutenant,<ref name="Republic 79" /> [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Two-Two]] also served in the unit.<ref name="Dark Times 2" />
